title: NFL's Marshawn Kneeland had CTE at 24. Alarming statistic shows that's not rare

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL's Marshawn Kneeland had CTE at 24. Alarming statistic shows that's not rare
sources.description: Cowboys DE Marshawn Kneeland had CTE when he died by suicide in November. His case is not rare despite the fact he was just 24 years old.
